Name: Tool Controls
Author: GJEET
Description:
This mod makes simple tweaks to the game to turn the character in the direction of your mouse for tools. For weapons, please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10496][Combat Controls Redux][/url].

[b]Installation:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][SMAPI][/url]﻿.
[*]Install via Vortex or unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*][b](OPTIONAL)[/b] - Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][Generic Mod Config Menu][/url]﻿ for easy config setting management.
[/list]
[b]Description:[/b]

This mod currently supports keyboard and mouse input only; controller functionality is not available. Minor animation inconsistencies may occur when using the Hoe, Watering Can, or Fishing Rod.

[b]Configuration:

[/b]You can change tool settings using the Generic Mod Config Menu in-game, or by editing the config.json file directly.

[b]Note:[/b] 

You can move while using the Hoe and Watering Can, but this feature is not available when using the Axe, Pickaxe, or Fishing Rod.
